Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/j-s-fletcher/the-borough-treasurer

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- J. S. Fletcher, the author, died 1935.

First publication of the text used: 1921 (SE colophon: 'The Borough Treasurer was published in 1921 by J. S. Fletcher.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1921, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 2016.
- Country of origin (possible countries: the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa): the last person to die, J. S. Fletcher, died 1935. With a term of life + 70 years, the text entered the public domain on 1 January 2006 in these countries. Each of the listed countries has a term of life + 70 years or less for these deaths, so the exact country, or a simultaneous first publication in two of them, does not change the result.
